title: Cairn beads bridge
description: Wires the GSD loop to the beads issue tracker (bd) so plain /gsd:* commands create, claim, close, and gate tracked work invisibly. Registers prompt contributions at plan:post (resolve each PLAN.md's requirements against the phase's bd issues, write beads: frontmatter, regenerate NN-BEADS-MAP.md), execute:wave:pre (claim every id in the dispatched plan's beads: frontmatter), execute:wave:post (close the completed plan's ids with a one-line SUMMARY reason, refresh the map), and verify:post (cross-check bd open state against the VERIFICATION report), plus a blocking ship:pre gate (zero non-closed issues labeled phase-<N> for any completed phase). NOTE on points: the claim hook registers at execute:wave:pre, not execute:pre, because the execute-phase workflow only renders wave-level pre hooks today (execute-phase.md step 2.75) — execute:pre is declared in the loop host contract but never dispatched. NOTE on the gate check form: the ship gate uses a command-exit-zero predicate (ADR-2008) rather than a named query because check-command-router only routes first-party query ids; the predicate runs the bundled deterministic script scripts/cairn-loop-gate.sh, which is what lets a third-party capability keep the gate blocking AND deterministic (agentVerdict is forced advisory). All bundled scripts no-op cleanly (exit 0, silent) when .beads/ or .planning/ is absent or cairn.enabled is false, so GSD behaves untouched in non-beads repos.

cairn.enabled.description: Master toggle for the cairn beads bridge. When false every cairn loop hook is inactive and the bundled scripts no-op, leaving GSD exactly as it behaves without beads.
